{{Quote|The ''Hound's Tooth'' was Bossk's pride and joy. More than that: his weapons, his way of making a living. You couldn't have bought this ship from him, for any amount of money.|[[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]|<ref name="Slave Ship">''[[Slave Ship]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Hound's Tooth''''' was a modified [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YV-666 light freighter/Legends|YV-666 light freighter]] owned by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]. Bossk acquired the ship after [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] destroyed his [[Bossk's freighter|former ship]] on [[Gandolo IV/Legends|Gandolo IV]].<ref name="EVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

==Description==
{{Quote|The stench onboard was horrible. Between drying Wookiee pelts, a rotting corpse on the skinning table, and Bossk's own repellent scent, it was worse than a slaughterhouse on a sewage planet.|[[Jan Ors]]|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
The exterior was smooth and rounded, with an elongated, rectangular hull originally meant for cargo transport. The ship also had a three-deck design and was protected by shields and reinforced armor.

[[File:HoundsTooth-GalacticHunters.jpg|thumb|left|''Hound's Tooth'']]
The ''Hound's Tooth''{{'s}} main deck contained Bossk's private quarters, a training chamber, an armory and an advanced medical bay. Its aft section was modified into a prison equipped with a series of magnetically reinforced holding cages which were connected to a force-field generator activated by motion sensors in the event a breakout took place. The prison also held Bossk's trophy collection and interrogation devices, as well as a skinning table for skinning his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] captives.

The command bridge was situated on top of the main hull and provided access to all the ''Hound's Tooth''{{'s}} systems. Its cockpit was equipped with a monitor bank which relayed information from hidden sensor screens, allowing the Trandoshan to monitor the entire vessel. The vessel also had an interior scanning system for monitoring cargo, motion sensors which were linked to neural stunners, sub-q injectors and shock panels, and voice-recognition security systems which prevented unauthorized access of the ship's ramp. These included anti-personnel [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] net and an electrocution array.

The bottom deck contained the ''Hound's Tooth''{{'s}} engines, power core, and weapons systems. The vehicle's armament were a turret-mounted quad-[[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], a secondary [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]], and a forward-firing [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] launcher that carried up to six missiles. A scout ship, ''[[Nashtah Pup/Legends|Nashtah Pup]]'', was stored in the interior for emergency operations. The ''Hound's Tooth'' was later stolen by [[Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin]] and [[Chenlambec]]. However, Bossk eventually retrieved his ship, even though [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] would later steal it as well.

[[File:Houndstooth_schem.jpg|left|thumb|''Hound's Tooth'' schematics]]
Its propulsion system was simple though it gave the ''Hound's Tooth'' a considerable amount of maneuverability despite its size. Its standard ion engines generated thrust while a pair of long maneuvering fins linked to the engines provided vertical movement. Two main drive nozzles between the fins of the vessel controlled turning.

The onboard systems were controlled by an [[X10-D]] [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] that was capable of responding to verbal commands from anywhere on the ship. It also controlled most of the ''Hound's Tooth''{{'s}} systems including weapons and security. The bridge and Bossk's private quarters also featured datalinks connected with the droid brain.
